description: iOS-only permissions: in-app OAuth session (guideline 4); the itms-apps URL that jumps to the App Store's subscription-management page (storage cancel); and opening http(s) URLs with an explicit application, which is what presenting them in the in-app SFSafariViewController sheet ('inAppBrowser') requires. Separate file from mobile.json because auth-session is only compiled for iOS - an Android ACL build must never see its permission identifier.
